[1/4] Plan: endgame run summary and story epilogues, career best-combo stat, CLI/Web legacy display, regression tests, ADR-012

impact_assessment.why: The new story, quest, contact, and combo systems currently end abruptly: terminal runs show only a generic banner, combo mastery is not recorded in the career dossier, and operative relationships never pay off in the ending.
impact_assessment.benefits: Players get closure and a reason to replay: epilogues reflect quest completion, operative trust, favors, and combo skill; career records best combo; CLI and Web show the same legacy summary.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: CareerProfile and full-state payload gain additive fields with defaults; dependency: none; concurrency: summary computed from locked session state; state: old saves must load with best_combo default and missing summary fields must stay optional
impact_assessment.mitigation: Use dataclass defaults, compute summaries from existing state only, add old-save fallback tests, keep CLI/Web parity tests, and run aikit fix/check before completion.

[1/4] Plan: Act III Agent Zero alliance choice, persistent story_choice, branching dialogue/epilogue, CLI/Web pact controls, tests, ADR-013

impact_assessment.why: Operative interactions currently change trust and rewards but never branch the story or the ending; Agent Zero is introduced as a rival with no meaningful decision attached.
impact_assessment.benefits: A one-time alliance/defiance decision makes character interactions consequential, changes late-act dialogue and epilogues, and gives players a replay-worthy narrative branch.
impact_assessment.risks: contract: GameState gains story_choice with a default; dependency: none; concurrency: choice mutates under the existing session lock; state: old saves load with an empty choice and no branch
impact_assessment.mitigation: Persist story_choice with a default, gate the choice to Act III, add old-save/default tests, keep unknown-mode errors explicit, and run aikit fix/check before completion.
